newsitem.title: INDIA: India needs new sugar technology-industry official.
newsitem.headline: India needs new sugar technology-industry official.

text.p: India should adopt modern technology to boost yields from sugarcane and make sugar prices globally competitive, an industry official said on Thursday.

For global price competitiveness, the conversion cost should be reduced by increasing plant size through automation and adoption of new technologies, said Shivaji Rao Patil, president of the National Federation of Co-operative Sugar Factories Ltd.
There was wide scope for stepping up investment in infrastructure for better handling of sugar exports, Patil said in a speech prepared for delivery to the Asia International Sugar Conference.
Patil did not attend the meeting because of ill health but his speech was made available to Reuters.
"The field is open for investment. We need to build up infrastructure for bulk handling of raw and white sugar at mills and at ports for speedy exports," Patil said.
